REQUEST FOR REVIEW COMMENTS
OCT 1 7 1975
TO:
Robert T. Kenney, Director, Boston Redevelopment Authority
BUSTON REUZ. ELU. INL. . MUTHORITY
OFFICE OF THE DIRECTOR Attached please find a description of the project referenced below. The Council requests that you consider whether this report adequately describes the project's impact upon your community and addresses significant environmental benefits and potential damages. We would appreciate your completing the form below and returning it to us. ATTN: METROPOLITAN CLEARINGHOUSE, by the due date.
COMMENTS DUE: 11/10/75
MAPC PROJECT NUMBER: EIS-76-9
REVIEW COMMENTS:
Adequately Describes Environmental Impacts (Explain Below).
Merits Further Environmental Study (Explain Below).
Need More Information (Explain Below).
EXPLANATORY COMMENTS: 
The Boston Redevelopment Authority reviewed the Draft Report on the Clearance of Unsafe Buildings and we feel that the Report was well prepared and adequately addressed the environmental impacts of the proposed project.
DIRECTOR
November 5, 1975
